account.tabs.label: Account
account.settings.title: Settings
account.settings.subtitle: Language, appearance and how you log in.
account.settings.preferencesText: Applies to your account on all devices.
account.methods.title: Login methods
account.methods.text: Ways you can log in. At least one method always remains.
account.methods.lastMethod: Your last login method can’t be removed.
account.methods.removeText: You will no longer be able to log in with {method} ({label}).
account.passkeys.title: Passkeys
account.passkeys.empty: No passkey yet. With a passkey you log in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock.
account.passkeys.addText: Your device will ask for your fingerprint, face or PIN. After that you log in with it.
account.passkeys.label: Name
account.passkeys.labelHint: So you recognise the passkey later, e.g. “Phone” or “Laptop”.
account.passkeys.deleteText: You will no longer be able to log in with “{label}”.
account.sessions.title: Signed-in devices
account.sessions.subtitle: Where you’re signed in right now. Don’t recognise a device? Sign it out.
account.sessions.onlyThis: You’re only signed in on this device.
account.sessions.loggedOutEverywhere: All other devices were signed out
account.sessions.revokeText: {device} will be signed out and has to log in again.
account.sessions.logoutEverywhereText: {count, plural, one {# other device} other {# other devices}} will be signed out. This device stays signed in.
account.securityLog.title: Security log
account.securityLog.subtitle: Logins and changes to your login methods.
account.securityLog.emptyText: Your logins and security changes to your account will appear here.
account.profile.title: My profile
account.settings.themeHint: Applies to all devices you’re logged in on.
account.sessions.logoutEverywhereHint: Lost a device or logged in on someone else’s computer? Log out all other devices at once.
account.profile.addressHint: Only the ambassadors of your region see your address.
account.photo.title: Profile photo
account.photo.text: Shown on your profile, in member lists and next to your posts.
account.photo.hint: Choose a picture, then move and zoom the square section. It is saved as a JPEG of at most 1 MB.
account.photo.removeText: Your initials will be shown instead of the photo.
account.settings.infoMail: Info mails from the foodsharing team
account.settings.infoMailHint: Important news for all members, also without newsletter subscription.
account.settings.mentions: Notify me when someone mentions me in the forum
account.settings.mentionsHint: You get a bell when someone writes @your name in a thread.
account.email.title: Email address
account.email.text: We send login links and notifications to this address.
account.email.abortText: The confirmation link sent to {email} will stop working.
account.email.newHint: We send a confirmation link to the new address. Your current address gets a notice with a link to cancel.
account.email.confirm.failedTitle: The address could not be changed
account.email.confirm.successText: From now on we write to {email}. You were logged out on your other devices.
account.email.abort.failedTitle: The change could not be cancelled
account.email.abort.successText: Your email address stays the same. If you did not request the change, please also change your login methods.
account.sleep.title: Sleep mode
account.sleep.text: Take a break: while you sleep, others see a moon next to your name and know you are not available for pickups.
account.sleep.currentFull: You are in sleep mode until you switch it off.
account.sleep.messageHint: Shown to members who may see your contact details.
account.sleep.messageTooLong: The message can have at most 1000 characters.
account.sleep.datesRequired: Please choose the first and the last day.
account.sleep.datesOrder: The last day must not be before the first day.
account.sleep.datesPast: The last day must not be in the past.
